title: charting_table.json
description: A scoping review's charted-study table (docs/PLAN.md M3; references/docs/design/multi-method-consensus.md §3.1 S5, §3.3 'Scoping review'). Written by the (not-yet-shipped) evidence-mapping skill once a method manifest's capture.mode is "charting" -- see methods/_schema.json's capture.mode enum and tools/method.py's resolve(). Rows carry provenance the same way extraction_table.json rows do (quote/locator, by/verified_by), plus suggested_by to distinguish an LLM-drafted field from one a connector filled in automatically (year/venue/publication type), which never needs reviewer confirmation.

charting_form_frozen.description: False during the pilot phase (5-10 records per §3.3); once true, the fields[] below may no longer change without a new pilot round (G-Freeze).

fields.description: The frozen charting form's field names, co-developed from the pack default and piloted before freeze -- empty while charting_form_frozen is false.

data.description: One key per frozen fields[] entry; values may be any JSON type the form's field calls for.

hash.description: sha256 of the exact source text `quote` was taken from, so a later reviewer can verify it wasn't altered.

suggested_by.description: "connector" fields (e.g. year, venue, publication type filled straight from records.jsonl) need no reviewer confirmation; "llm"-suggested fields do, per §3.1 S5's G-Values gate.
